story_fits.scene: At Victoria Falls a page blows toward the edge. Clyde narrates his own slow-mo 'action scene' (dramatic dive, spray, hero pose) and misses it by a metre. Mtoriro, who does the same boring stretch every morning, simply steps on it. Cut on the spray hiding something on the far bank.
story_fits.rule_line: SLOW-MO LOOKS COOL. STRETCHING CATCHES PAGES.
story_fits.technique: RECEIPT (the one metre he missed by)
story_fits.button: Clyde: 'BET. RUN IT BACK IN SLOW-MO.' and slips into the spray.

story_fits.trend: Christmas songs surging worldwide and US (All I Want for Christmas Is You, Last Christmas): festive family mood
story_fits.scene: On the train toward Victoria Falls, Mtoriro's aunties video-call for an early festive check-in: 'Still no wife? Still chasing paper?' Clyde tries to help by answering for him and promises the aunties a wedding by Christmas.
story_fits.lesson: Love your family without letting their plans run your life.
story_fits.rule_line: RESPECT YOUR AUNTIES. THEIR PLANS AREN'T A GROUP VOTE.
story_fits.button: Clyde: 'TOO LATE. I ALREADY SENT A SAVE THE DATE.'
story_fits.safety: No song in the video; manual posting only.

story_fits.trend: Trend videos #2-3: small-business origin story and a comedy skit about supporting a partner's business (storytelling formats)
story_fits.scene: A tuck-shop owner at Bulawayo station reminds Clyde he promised to support her shop. He proudly shows the 40 posts he shared; he never bought one thing. He confesses he hasn't paid since ep 31's bun.
story_fits.lesson: Real support means keeping your promise, not just hyping.
story_fits.rule_line: 40 SHARES. ZERO BUNS BOUGHT. LIKES DON'T PAY RENT.
story_fits.button: Clyde: 'BET. CAN I PAY IN EXPOSURE?'

story_fits.chapter: 4, ep 32 MISTAKE (Mtoriro's family; family pressure, promises)
story_fits.scene: Mtoriro's grandmother quizzes the crew in a family trivia game before she shares what she knows about the Prof. Clyde, who swore he knows Mtoriro 'like a brother', gets every question wrong, including Mtoriro's real first name. The last question is about the Prof, and only Gogo knows the answer.
story_fits.lesson: If you say someone matters, prove it by paying attention.
story_fits.rule_line: BEST FRIENDS KNOW BIRTHDAYS. YOU KNOW HIS WIFI PASSWORD.
story_fits.button: Clyde: 'PHONE A FRIEND?' and calls Mtoriro, who is standing next to him.
